source.text: Patients must have disease that is metastatic or unresectable
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1.
Measurable disease per disease-specific response criteria.
History of uveitis, or an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in the past 2 years
Pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning to become pregnant while enrolled in this study or within 6 months after the last dose of NX-1607.
Use of systemic corticosteroids (\> 20 mg prednisone or equivalent) within 15 days
autologous or allogeneic stem cell transplant within 100 days
